title: Geno Smith out on Friday due to foot soreness, Cade Klubnik will start for Jets

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Geno Smith out on Friday due to foot soreness, Cade Klubnik will start for Jets
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said this week that the team's starters would play against the Buccaneers on Friday night, but there's one significant change to that plan.
